newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Owners see a positive trend.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Owners see a positive trend.

text.p: Busy conditions prevailed again in the freight market with a generally positive trend for owners.

The exception has been for Handy-sizes in the Western and South Atlantic where rates, especially in the grain trades, have remained soft. On the other hand, Capers continued to enjoy steady demand, strengthening in the Atlantic, and the situation for modern Panamaxes was much the same.
Owners were said to be benefiting from longer voyage durations caused by bad weather and widespread port congestion. The BFI ended the week with a small gain of 2 points to 1507.

MSK's fixture of the Halla-relet Yu May for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Japan for Jan 25 cancelling at $27.25 no combo was a significant increase on last done 10 days ago at $26.05 by Klaveness for Jan 15/25. Cargill and Cobelfret remain open for Panamaxes for US Gulf/Continent for Jan loading (Cobelfret's ideas said to be 2.75), and Cargill are said to have booked a Handy-size on this route.

Tradigrain fixed Axion 60,024 dwt delivery passing Durban retro Jan 5 trip via ECSA redelivery E Med at $11,500 daily. New Atlantic orders included Grain Coop for a Panamax delivery Paranagua mid Feb trip Continent and Soufflet 50,000/10 barley Bahia Blanca/Red Sea or Arabian Gulf for Jan 29/Feb 5.

Andre quoted 20,000 wheat St Lawrence/Tema for Jan 25/Feb 10 and 15/17,000 pellets Up River/Constanza for Jan 20/30. Number of weak Handy grain fixtures were reported but full details of Tradigrain's booking of a Fortune type for about 20,000 grains Paranagua/France or Spain were not disclosed. In the Pacific Dreyfus are said to have fixed Kavo Kaliakra for 55,000 barley NoPac/Saudi Arabia prompt at $21.00 and to have another similar stem to cover. NSAC quoted timecharter requirements for 26,000 wheat NoPac/Taiwan for Jan 20/Feb 10 and 34,000 Feb 1/20.

Despite a weak Caper fixtur of Tai Shan for 140,000 ironore Tubarao/2 China by Noble for early Feb at $10.00 and Shougang tonnage to Rohstoffhandel for two Feb shipments of 180,000 Ponta da Madeira to Rotterdam at $5.00 (other charterers are said to be firm at $6.00 for similar business), brokers maintained that Caper rates were rising in the Atlantic.

Portland Star 150,000 dwt is believed fixed for a transatlantic round at a firmer level by MOSK, and possibly also Irongate 180,000 for Brazilian ore to other charterers but details of these fixtures are still awaited. Sideco fixed Rhodos for 110,000/10 ironore Narvik/Dunkirk for mid Jan at $4.80. Brokers are confident that well in excess of $6.00 will shortly be reported for 110,000 coal Hampton Roads/Rotterdam (BFI route 7).

In the East the Bocimar newbuilding Channel Navigator 170,000 dwt is reported fixed by Docenave delivery mid Jan Japan for 2 laden legs. Panamax mineral business included reports that Noble booked Petriana 64,000 on timecharter for ironore Goa/China and Cetragpa fixed about 70,000 coal Richards Bay/N France in the region of $9.00/9.50 for end Jan. Period timecharter of Panamaxes with Far East deliveries has been an important feature of this week and today Full Comfort 70,181 dwt was linked with Klaveness for 12 months at close to $11,250 daily, Full Beauty 70,198 dwt to Halla at the same level with an option of a 2nd year at $12,250 daily, and Ikan Bilis 63,800 dwt to Korea Line on private terms.

UBT booked Atlantica 63,990 dwt for fertilizers Black Sea/China on subjects, and there were reports of 50,000 urea fixed on this route at $24.50/25.50 (possibly Ektor 64,285 dwt). Panaghiotis l fixed and failed on subjects with Atlantic fertilizers for 50,000 dap Tampa/China at $28.00.

Pan Ocean and Moller were both said to have booked tonnage of 40/45,000 t Continent/Far East at close to $12,000 daily. Markos N 38,054 dwt was chartered from the Continent prompt to US Gulf at $6,250/6,500 daily. Danish charterers fixed Essar Kaptanoglou 37,000 dwt delivery E Med end Jan for 3-5 months at $7,750 daily, and Grant took Tribuno 38,000 dwt delivery Brazil mid Jan trip Far East at $9,000 plus unknown bonus. In a firmer Far East market Emerald 46,000 dwt went to NYK delivery prompt Bangkok trip via Australia to Japan at $8,750 daily. Korea line fix Georgia 38,000 dwt delivery NoPac mid Jan trip Far East at about $7,200 daily plus $120,000 bonus.
